annotations.title: Delivery fee + order quote for a California destination

description: Quote what a delivery to a California address/city costs (the nursery's own calculator: Google driving round trip from Sonoma × $3/mile under 199 round-trip miles or $2/mile at 199+, capped at $1,450) and, when product + quantity are given, the published per-plant tier, product subtotal, whether the order qualifies for FREE delivery, and the total. Use this instead of estimating prices or delivery costs yourself. Fee-only: it cannot see or book delivery schedules. Set pickup=true for a pickup-only price.

destination.description: Delivery address, city or ZIP in California (required unless pickup=true)

pickup.description: true = customer picks up at the Sonoma nursery (no delivery fee)

product.description: clones = fresh rooted clones; talls = clearance talls; teens = one-gallon ready-to-flip teens; teens_4in = teens in 4-inch pots; snips = unrooted cuttings
